title: Queer and Trans Cultural Production
description: Experimental, practice-based course. Examines how artists validate, deepen, and disrupt well- established histories, genres and genealogies of knowledge about gender and sexuality in the academy and the arts. Key topics of abolition, identity, archives, decolonization, intersectionality, representation, performance and community explored through case studies in graphic novels, documentary, photography, music, writing and curation.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of GNDR 328, GNDR 349 (if taken in the same topic).
